newsitem.title: USA: Community Trust sees full year flat to down.
newsitem.headline: Community Trust sees full year flat to down.

text.p: Community Trust Bancorp Inc said that it expects full year earnings before extraordinary items to be relatively flat to down slightly against last year.
The company reported net income of $18.8 million for full 1996.
Earnings for the six months ending June 30 were marginally below management's original expectations, the company said in a news release.
For the six months ended July 30, the company reported earnings per share of $0.90 before an extraordinary gain and $1.20 after an extraordinary gain.
The company said gains on the sale of its West Liberty affiliate and the settlement in the first quarter of a lawsuit with a vendor added about $5.5 million.
Several initiatives that would enhance future earnings were undertaken by management which will continue to impact earnings for the remainder of the year, the release said.
